findings.summary: Exported predicate is unused outside its own unit test.
findings.consequence: The module exposes and tests a second control-character concept that no production caller consumes, increasing API surface and making future callers choose between overlapping predicates without an observed need.
findings.evidence: Current source search for `hasC0OrDelete` finds only the export at `shared/utils/text-safety.ts:1` and `test/unit/text-safety.spec.ts` imports/assertions. The packet's listed production callers import neighboring predicates such as `hasC0OrC1Control` and `hasLoneSurrogate`, not this function.
findings.recommendation: Delete `hasC0OrDelete` and remove its dedicated expectations from `test/unit/text-safety.spec.ts`, unless there is an intended external API contract not represented in this repository.
